# Prime Video

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 4 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Signed-out streaming marketing: near-black page, white trial button, translucent blue nav action, Amazon sign-in wall.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Public marketing and login chrome only. No account, no card, no playback.. Themes: dark.

Signed-out public chrome for Prime Video, captured 2026-11-19 from a live browser tab. The start URL `https://www.primevideo.com/` redirected to the Singapore non-Prime marketing page (`/offers/nonprimehomepage`). Join Prime redirected to Amazon sign-in at `amazon.sg/ap/signin`. No account was created, no field was filled, and no card was entered. The viewport measured 1169 by 731 CSS pixels at device pixel ratio 2. Screenshots were not produced: the preview browser returned "The browser is not producing screenshot frames."

### Fonts (from README.md)

Amazon Ember is the marketing page's computed family, with Amazon Arabic Ember, then Arial, then sans-serif. It is Amazon's font and is not included here. The Amazon sign-in wall computed Arial, sans-serif. Ember had not loaded there.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The light set is Amazon's sign-in page, not a Prime Video light theme. The marketing page did not offer a theme switch. `text.secondary` on that wall is the same computed colour as `text.primary`, because the page did not paint a second text colour. The email field's blue border is the focused state. The unfocused password border was `#888c8c`. Nav `lineHeight` of 18px comes from `--fable-typography-label-100-line-height`. The computed value was `normal`. Heading 600 and heading 400 were on `:root` and were not used by a visible heading. Dialog radius was a custom property. No dialog was opened. Prices on the page are Singapore dollars.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the near-black page and the white trial button.** The marketing page paints `rgb(0, 5, 13)` on the body and a white 60px button with 8px radius for "Start your 30-day free trial". The frame that should show this was not produced: [screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png](screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png).
- **Keep Join Prime as the translucent blue nav action.** Its computed background is `rgba(26, 152, 255, 0.8)`, 14px medium Ember, 8px radius, 38px tall. See [screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png](screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png).
- **Treat the yellow Continue button as Amazon's wall, not Prime Video's.** It is `#ffd814`, pill-shaped, on a white card with a `#d5d9d9` border. See [screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png](screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png).
- **Do not invent a light theme for the marketing site.** None was on the page. See [screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png](screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png).
- **Do not ship Amazon Ember as if it were licensed here.** Name the family. Do not add the font files. See [screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png](screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png).
